items.title: Collect a Blood pack
items.detail: Check tables and first aid boxes in Summersville, or loot Blood Eagles.

items.title: Build Anything in a Shelter in Free Cam
items.detail: Enter your C.A.M.P. Shelter, switch to Free Cam before placing an item.

items.title: Collect Mirelurk Eggs
items.detail: Collect from nests at Ohio River Adventures; Mirelurk Hatchlings may spawn.

items.title: Kill a Mirelurk
items.detail: Spruce Knob Lake is a reliable spawn; use V.A.T.S. on the head.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Ash Heap Region
items.detail: Camden Park has dense Scorched spawns.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Shotgun
items.detail: Eastern Regional Penitentiary has close-range encounters with Feral Ghouls.

items.title: Sell a Black Powder Pistol to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Whitespring Resort or any train station vendor will buy it.

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any small decoration or C.A.M.P. piece at your C.A.M.P. or claimed workshop.

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Pull from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies.

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench; requires Steel scrap and Plastic.

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft at a Tinker's Workbench; requires Wood scraps and Plastic.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has dense Super Mutant spawns; use Enforcer perk or V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Blackwater Mine spawns up to 25 Mole Miners; use V.A.T.S. on the head.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start Head Hunt at Highway Town Bounty Board; any bladed melee weapon works.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps or excavator power armor mod boxes at any workbench.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to any NPC vendor; Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers rare plans and items at reduced gold prices.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Extra Caps rewards and mutated enemies with double mutations active.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutated variants offering special rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience gains across all activities.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) and Season 27 Start
events.description: New World Pets feature launches alongside Season 27 'You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.'.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with double mutations for increased loot and rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Scorched enemies dressed for the holidays spawn throughout Appalachia with festive rewards.
